query: 童颜针 肿胀期 多久 消肿 按摩 注意事项
reason: New-signal supplement from Rednote pass 2026-09-20: 肿胀期 (swelling phase) NEW concern chip on 童颜针 search, paired with 按摩手法 chip; establish the public aftercare discourse baseline.
keyFindings: Swelling mechanism: 童颜针 reconstituted with sterile water + anesthetic → larger injected volume than HA; prominent facial edema first 24-48h, typically resolving in 3-7 days
5-5-5 massage rule (classic 3D Sculptra protocol): 5 consecutive days × 5 times/day × 5 min, point-line-plane technique — purpose is even PLLA distribution, nodule/swelling prevention
4D-generation products (finer particles, 1-min reconstitution) claim in-clinic massage only, no home massage required — protocol divergence by product generation
Early firmness/nodules within first month may reflect collagen not yet softened; massage + follow-up; persistent lumps need clinic review
General aftercare: no makeup 24h, avoid heat (sauna/hot spring/sun), alcohol/spicy, strenuous exercise, acids/retinoids ~1 week; follow-up at 6-12 months for maintenance

Contraindication lists circulating: keloid history, pregnancy/breastfeeding, PLLA allergy, active inflammation, rheumatoid/severe autoimmune disease, coagulation disorders/anticoagulants, not for lips
